integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. An elderly street musician plays a trumpet alone in a laundromat at 3 a.m, fog drifting through the light of a single lamp. The camera arcs around the subject at slow speed. A few coins glint in an open case at their feet. Their eyes are closed.

overall_soundscape: A slow, bare trumpet melody is played live, close to the microphone and a city hums in the distance.
